Yeh saahib-e-izzat o hikmat Khuda ki naazil ki hui kitaab hai
Hum ne aap ki taraf is kitaab ko haq ke saath naazil kiya hai, lihaaza aap mukammal ikhlaas ke saath Khuda ki ibaadat karein

Aagaah ho jaao ke khaalis bandagi sirf Allah ke liye hai, aur jin logon ne us ke ilaawa sarparast banaaye hain yeh keh kar ke hum un ki parastish sirf is liye karte hain ke yeh humein Allah se qareeb kar denge, Allah un ke darmiyaan tamaam ikhtilaafi masaail mein faisla kar dega, ke Allah kisi bhi jhoote aur naashukri karne waale ko hidaayat nahin deta hai
Aur woh agar chaahta ke apna farzand banaaye to apni makhlooqaat mein jise chaahta us ka intikhaab kar leta. Woh paak o be-niyaaz hai, aur wahi Khuda-e-Yakta aur Qahhaar hai

Us ne aasmaan o zameen ko haq ke saath paida kiya hai. Woh raat ko din par lapet deta hai aur din ko raat par, aur us ne aaftaab aur maahtaab ko taabe' bana diya hai, sab ek muqarrara muddat tak chalte rahenge. Aagaah ho jaao woh sab par ghaalib aur bahut bakhshne waala hai

Us ne tum sab ko ek hi nafs se paida kiya hai aur phir usi se us ka joda qaraar diya hai, aur tumhaare liye aath qism ke chaupaaye naazil kiye hain. Woh tum ko tumhaari maaon ke shikam mein takhleeq ki mukhtalif manzilon se guzaarta hai, aur yeh sab teen taareekiyon mein hota hai. Wahi Allah tumhaara Parwardigar hai, usi ke qabze mein mulk hai, us ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, phir tum kidhar phire ja rahe ho

Agar tum kaafir bhi ho jaaoge to Khuda tum se be-niyaaz hai, aur woh apne bandon ke liye kufr ko pasand nahin karta hai, aur agar tum us ka shukriya ada karoge to woh is baat ko pasand karta hai. Aur koi shakhs doosre ke gunaahon ka bojh uthaane waala nahin hai. Us ke baad tum sab ki baazgasht tumhaare Parwardigar ki taraf hai, phir woh tumhein bataaega ke tum duniya mein kya kar rahe the, woh dilon ke chhupe hue raazon se bhi baakhabar hai

Aur jab insaan ko koi takleef pahunchti hai to poori tawajjoh ke saath Parwardigar ko aawaaz deta hai. Phir jab woh use koi ne'mat de deta hai to jis baat ke liye us ko pukaar raha tha use yaksar nazar-andaaz kar deta hai, aur Khuda ke liye misl qaraar deta hai taake us ke raaste se behka sake. To aap keh dijiye ke thode dinon apne kufr mein aish kar lo, us ke baad to tum yaqeenan Jahannam waalon mein ho

Kya woh shakhs jo raat ki ghadiyon mein sajde aur qiyaam ki haalat mein Khuda ki ibaadat karta hai aur aakhirat ka khauf rakhta hai aur apne Parwardigar ki rehmat ka umeedwaar hai (us ke baraabar ho sakta hai jo aisa nahin)? Keh dijiye ke kya woh log jo jaante hain un ke baraabar ho jaayenge jo nahin jaante hain? Is baat se naseehat sirf saahibaan-e-aql haasil karte hain

Keh dijiye ke aye mere imaandaar bando! Apne Parwardigar se daro. Jo log is daar-e-duniya mein neki karte hain un ke liye neki hai, aur Allah ki zameen bahut wasee' hai. Bas sabr karne waale hi woh hain jin ko be-hisaab ajr diya jaata hai
Keh dijiye ke mujhe hukm diya gaya hai ke main ikhlaas-e-ibaadat ke saath Allah ki ibaadat karoon
Aur mujhe hukm diya gaya hai ke main sab se pehla itaa'at-guzaar ban jaaoon
Keh dijiye ke main gunaah karoon to mujhe bade sakht din ke azaab ka khauf hai
Keh dijiye ke main sirf Allah ki ibaadat karta hoon aur apni ibaadat mein mukhlis hoon
Ab tum jis ki chaaho ibaadat karo. Keh dijiye ke haqeeqi khasaare waale wahi hain jinhon ne apne nafs aur apne ahl ko qiyaamat ke din ghaate mein rakha. Aagaah ho jaao yahi khula hua khasaara hai
Un ke liye oopar se Jahannam ki aag ke odhne honge aur neeche se bichhaune. Yahi woh baat hai jis se Khuda apne bandon ko daraata hai, to aye mere bando! Mujh se daro

Aur jin logon ne zaalimon se alaihdagi ikhtiyaar ki is se ke un ki ibaadat karein, aur Khuda ki taraf mutawajjeh ho gaye, un ke liye hamaari taraf se bashaarat hai. Lihaaza Paighambar! Aap mere bandon ko bashaarat de dijiye
Jo baaton ko sunte hain aur jo baat achchhi hoti hai us ka ittibaa' karte hain. Yahi woh log hain jinhein Khuda ne hidaayat di hai aur yahi woh log hain jo saahibaan-e-aql hain
Kya jis shakhs par kalima-e-azaab saabit ho jaaye, aur kya jo shakhs Jahannam mein chala hi jaaye, aap use nikaal sakte hain

Albatta jin logon ne apne Parwardigar ka khauf paida kiya un ke liye Jannat ke ghurfe hain aur un ke ghurfon par mazeed ghurfe hain jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi. Yeh Khuda ka waada hai, aur Khuda apne waade ke khilaaf nahin karta hai

Kya tum ne nahin dekha ke Khuda ne aasmaan se paani naazil kiya hai, phir use mukhtalif chashmon mein jaari kar diya hai, phir us ke zariye mukhtalif rang ki zaraa'at paida karta hai, phir woh khaiti sookh jaati hai to use zard rang mein dekhte ho, phir use bhoosa bana deta hai. In tamaam baaton mein saahibaan-e-aql ke liye yaad-dahaani aur naseehat ka saamaan paaya jaata hai

Kya woh shakhs jis ke dil ko Khuda ne Islam ke liye kushaada kar diya hai to woh apne Parwardigar ki taraf se nooraaniyat ka haamil hai, gumraahon jaisa ho sakta hai? Afsos un logon ke haal par jin ke dil zikr-e-Khuda ke liye sakht ho gaye hain, to woh khuli hui gumraahi mein mubtala hain

Allah ne behtareen kalaam is kitaab ki shakl mein naazil kiya hai jis ki aayatein aapas mein milti julti hain aur baar baar dohraayi gayi hain, ke un se khauf-e-Khuda rakhne waalon ke rongte khade ho jaate hain, us ke baad un ke jism aur dil yaad-e-Khuda ke liye narm ho jaate hain. Yahi Allah ki waaqai hidaayat hai, woh jis ko chaahta hai ata farma deta hai, aur jis ko woh gumraahi mein chhod de us ka koi hidaayat karne waala nahin hai

Kya woh shakhs jo roz-e-qiyaamat badtareen azaab ka bachaao apne chehre se karne waala hai najaat paane waale ke baraabar ho sakta hai? Aur zaalimeen se to yahi kaha jaaega ke apne kartoot ka maza chakho
Aur in kuffaar se pehle waalon ne bhi rasoolon ko jhutlaaya to un par is tarah se azaab waarid ho gaya ke inhein us ka sha'oor bhi nahin tha
Phir Khuda ne inhein zindagi-e-duniya mein zillat ka maza chakhaaya, aur aakhirat ka azaab to bahar-haal bahut bada hai, agar inhein maaloom ho sake
Aur hum ne logon ke liye is Quran mein har tarah ki misaal bayaan kar di hai ke shaayad yeh ibrat aur naseehat haasil kar sakein
Yeh Arabi zabaan ka Quran hai jis mein kisi tarah ki kaji nahin hai, shaayad yeh log isi tarah taqwa ikhtiyaar kar lein

Allah ne us shakhs ki misaal bayaan ki hai jis mein bahut se jhagda karne waale shuraka hon, aur woh shakhs jo ek hi shakhs ke supurd ho jaaye. Kya dono haalaat ke etibaar se ek jaise ho sakte hain? Saari taareef Allah ke liye hai, magar un ki aksariyat samajhti hi nahin hai
Paighambar! Aap ko bhi maut aane waali hai aur yeh sab mar jaane waale hain
Us ke baad tum sab roz-e-qiyaamat Parwardigar ki baargaah mein apne jhagde pesh karoge
To us se bada zaalim kaun hai jo Khuda par bohtaan baandhe aur sadaaqat ke aa jaane ke baad us ki takzeeb kare? To kya Jahannam mein kaafireen ka thikaana nahin hai
Aur jo shakhs sadaaqat ka paighaam le kar aaya aur jis ne us ki tasdeeq ki, yahi log dar-haqeeqat saahibaan-e-taqwa aur parhezgaar hain
Un ke liye Parwardigar ke yahaan woh sab kuch hai jo woh chaahte hain, aur yahi nek amal waalon ki jaza hai
Taake Khuda un buraaiyon ko door kar de jo un se sarzad hui hain, aur un ka ajr un ke aamaal se behtar taur par ata kare
Kya Khuda apne bandon ke liye kaafi nahin hai? Aur yeh log aap ko us ke ilaawa doosron se daraate hain, haalaanke jis ko Khuda gumraahi mein chhod de us ka koi hidaayat karne waala nahin hai
Aur jis ko woh hidaayat de de us ka koi gumraah karne waala nahin hai. Kya Khuda sab se zyaada zabardast intiqaam lene waala nahin hai

Aur agar aap un se sawaal karenge ke zameen o aasmaan ko kis ne paida kiya hai to kahenge ke Allah. To keh dijiye ke kya tum ne un sab ka haal dekha hai jin ki ibaadat karte ho, ke agar Khuda nuqsaan pahunchaane ka iraada kar le to kya yeh us nuqsaan ko rok sakte hain, ya agar woh rehmat ka iraada kar le to kya yeh us rehmat ko mana kar sakte hain? Aap keh dijiye ke mere liye mera Khuda kaafi hai, aur bharosa karne waale usi par bharosa karte hain
Aur keh dijiye ke qaum waalo! Tum apni jagah par amal karo aur main apna amal kar raha hoon, us ke baad anqareeb tumhein sab ka haal maaloom ho jaaega
Ke kis ke paas ruswa karne waala azaab aata hai aur kis par hamesha rehne waala azaab naazil hota hai

Hum ne is kitaab ko aap ke paas logon ki hidaayat ke liye haq ke saath naazil kiya hai. Ab jo hidaayat haasil kar lega woh apne faaide ke liye karega, aur jo gumraah ho jaaega woh bhi apna hi nuqsaan karega, aur aap un ke zimmedaar nahin hain

Allah hi hai jo roohon ko maut ke waqt apni taraf bula leta hai, aur jo nahin marte hain un ki roohon ko bhi neend ke waqt talab kar leta hai, aur phir jis ki maut ka faisla kar leta hai us ki rooh ko rok leta hai aur doosri roohon ko ek muqarrara muddat ke liye aazaad kar deta hai. Is baat mein saahibaan-e-fikr o nazar ke liye bahut si nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain

Kya un logon ne Khuda ko chhod kar sifaarish karne waale ikhtiyaar kar liye hain? To aap keh dijiye ke aisa kyon hai, chaahe yeh log koi ikhtiyaar na rakhte hon aur kisi tarah ki bhi aql na rakhte hon
Keh dijiye ke shafaa'at ka tamaam-tar ikhtiyaar Allah ke haathon mein hai, usi ke paas zameen o aasmaan ka saara iqtidaar hai, aur us ke baad tum bhi usi ki baargaah mein palataaye jaaoge
Aur jab un ke saamne Khuda-e-Yakta ka zikr aata hai to jin ka imaan aakhirat par nahin hai un ke dil mutanaffir ho jaate hain, aur jab us ke ilaawa kisi aur ka zikr aata hai to khush ho jaate hain

Ab aap kahiye ke aye Parwardigar! Aye zameen o aasmaan ke khalq karne waale aur haazir o ghaaib ke jaanne waale! Tu hi apne bandon ke darmiyaan un masaail ka faisla kar sakta hai jin mein yeh aapas mein ikhtilaaf kar rahe hain

Aur agar zulm karne waalon ko zameen ki tamaam kaainaat mil jaaye aur utna hi aur bhi mil jaaye to bhi yeh roz-e-qiyaamat ke badtareen azaab ke badle mein sab de denge, lekin un ke liye Khuda ki taraf se woh sab bahar-haal zaahir hoga jis ka yeh wahm o gumaan bhi nahin rakhte the
Aur un ki saari badkirdaariyaan un par waazeh ho jaayengi, aur inhein wahi baat apne ghere mein le legi jis ka yeh mazaaq udaaya karte the

Phir jab insaan ko koi takleef pahunchti hai to humein pukaarta hai, aur us ke baad jab hum koi ne'mat de dete hain to kehta hai ke yeh to mujhe mere ilm ke zor par di gayi hai, haalaanke yeh ek aazmaaish hai, aur aksar log is ka ilm nahin rakhte hain
In se pehle waalon ne bhi yahi kaha tha, to woh kuch un ke kaam nahin aaya jise woh haasil kar rahe the

Balke un ke aamaal ke bure asaraat un tak pahunch gaye, aur in kuffaar mein se bhi jo log zulm karne waale hain un tak un ke aamaal ke bure asaraat pahunchenge, aur woh Khuda ko aajiz nahin kar sakte hain

Kya inhein yeh nahin maaloom hai ke Allah hi jis ke rizq ko chaahta hai wasee' kar deta hai aur jis ke rizq ko chaahta hai tang kar deta hai? In mu'aamlaat mein saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye bahut si nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain

Paighambar! Aap paighaam pahuncha dijiye ke aye mere bando jinhon ne apne nafs par zyaadati ki hai! Rehmat-e-Khuda se maayoos na hona, Allah tamaam gunaahon ka maaf karne waala hai, aur woh yaqeenan bahut zyaada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai
Aur tum sab apne Parwardigar ki taraf rujoo karo aur us ke liye saraapa tasleem ho jaao, qabl is ke ke tum tak azaab aa jaaye, to phir tumhaari madad nahin ki ja sakti hai
Aur tumhaare Rab ki taraf se jo behtareen qaanoon naazil kiya gaya hai us ka ittibaa' karo, qabl is ke ke tum tak achaanak azaab aa jaaye aur tumhein us ka sha'oor bhi na ho
Phir tum mein se koi nafs yeh kehne lage ke haaye afsos ke main ne Khuda ke haq mein badi kotaahi ki hai aur main mazaaq udaane waalon mein se tha
Ya yeh kehne lage ke agar Khuda mujhe hidaayat de deta to main bhi saahibaan-e-taqwa mein se ho jaata
Ya azaab ke dekhne ke baad yeh kehne lage ke agar mujhe dobaara waapas jaane ka mauqa mil jaaye to main nek kirdaar logon mein se ho jaaoonga
Haan haan, tere paas meri aayatein aayi thin to tu ne unhein jhutla diya aur takabbur se kaam liya aur kaafiron mein se ho gaya
Aur tum roz-e-qiyaamat dekhoge ke jin logon ne Allah par bohtaan baandha hai un ke chehre siyaah ho gaye hain. Aur kya Jahannam mein takabbur karne waalon ka thikaana nahin hai
Aur Khuda saahibaan-e-taqwa ko un ki kaamyaabi ke sabab najaat de dega, ke koi buraai inhein chhoo bhi na sakegi aur na inhein koi ranj laahiq hoga
Allah hi har shai ka khaaliq hai aur wahi har cheez ki nigraani karne waala hai
Zameen o aasmaan ki tamaam kunjiyaan usi ke paas hain, aur jin logon ne us ki aayaton ka inkaar kiya wahi khasaare mein rehne waale hain
Aap keh dijiye ke aye jaahilo! Kya tum mujhe is baat ka hukm dete ho ke main ghair-e-Khuda ki ibaadat karne lagoon

Aur yaqeenan tumhaari taraf aur tum se pehle waalon ki taraf yahi wahi ki gayi hai ke agar tum shirk ikhtiyaar karoge to tumhaare tamaam aamaal barbaad kar diye jaayenge aur tumhaara shumaar ghaate waalon mein ho jaaega
Tum sirf Allah ki ibaadat karo aur us ke shukr-guzaar bandon mein ho jaao

Aur un logon ne waaqai Allah ki qadr nahin ki hai, jab ke roz-e-qiyaamat tamaam zameen usi ki mutthi mein hogi aur saare aasmaan usi ke haath mein lipte hue honge. Woh paak o be-niyaaz hai aur jin cheezon ko yeh us ka shareek banaate hain un se buland o baala-tar hai

Aur jab Soor phoonka jaaega to zameen o aasmaan ki tamaam makhlooqaat behosh ho kar gir padengi, ilaawa un ke jinhein Khuda bachaana chaahe. Us ke baad phir dobaara phoonka jaaega to sab khade ho kar dekhne lagenge

Aur zameen apne Rab ke noor se jagmaga uthegi, aur aamaal ki kitaab rakh di jaaegi, aur anbiya aur shuhada ko laaya jaaega, aur un ke darmiyaan haq o insaaf ke saath faisla kiya jaaega, aur kisi par zulm nahin kiya jaaega
Aur phir har nafs ko us ke aamaal ka poora poora badla diya jaaega, aur woh sab ke aamaal se poore taur se baakhabar hai

Aur kufr ikhtiyaar karne waalon ko giroh dar giroh Jahannam ki taraf hankaaya jaaega, yahaan tak ke us ke saamne pahunch jaayenge to us ke darwaaze khol diye jaayenge, aur us ke khaazin sawaal karenge: kya tumhaare paas rasool nahin aaye the jo aayaat-e-Rab ki tilaawat karte aur tumhein aaj ke din ki mulaaqaat se daraate? To sab kahenge ke beshak rasool aaye the, lekin kaafireen ke haq mein kalima-e-azaab bahar-haal saabit ho chuka hai
To kaha jaaega ke ab Jahannam ke darwaazon se daakhil ho jaao aur usi mein hamesha hamesha raho, ke takabbur karne waalon ka bahut bura thikaana hota hai

Aur jin logon ne apne Rab ka taqwa ikhtiyaar kiya inhein Jannat ki taraf giroh dar giroh le jaaya jaaega, yahaan tak ke jab us ke qareeb pahunchenge aur us ke darwaaze khol diye jaayenge to us ke khazaana-daar kahenge ke tum par hamaara salaam ho, tum paak o paakeeza ho, lihaaza hamesha ke liye Jannat mein daakhil ho jaao

Aur woh kahenge ke shukr-e-Khuda hai ke us ne hum se kiye hue apne waade ko sach kar dikhaaya hai, aur humein apni zameen ka waaris bana diya hai ke Jannat mein jahaan chaahein aaraam karein, aur beshak yeh amal karne waalon ka behtareen ajr hai

Aur tum dekhoge ke malaaika Arsh-e-Ilaahi ke gird ghera daale hue apne Rab ki hamd ki tasbeeh kar rahe hain, aur logon ke darmiyaan haq o insaaf ke saath faisla kar diya jaaega, aur har taraf ek hi aawaaz hogi ke Al-hamdu lillaahi Rabb-il-Aalameen
